The IIT provides immersive, scenario-based training that evaluates and prepares Marines for complex environments, including urban areas where hostile forces may be present, while allowing them to build infantry tactics and skills. Hernandez is a native of California. (U.S. Marine Corps photo by Cpl. Journey Fisher)
